status_of_prior_holdout: The v0 holdout is frozen as a failed confirmation. It may motivate architecture revision but is never reused as v1 confirmation evidence.
purpose: Confirm a revised incumbent-preserving VoC architecture that removes the brittle initial-gap rejection and treats a verified positive certificate as evidence to finish the challenger rather than stopping at the first one-node crossing.
search_contract: Identical to challenger_voc_dev_v0: two-arm incumbent first; independently chosen seeded start; one-variable relocation neighborhood; width<=current+1 filter; strict live-node improvement after complete stages; max two accepted moves; all challenger BDD candidate compilations charged; cross-order Hamming-rank oracle plus endpoint-local exhaustive truth.

frozen_v1_policy.name: uniform64_gap11_then128_gap9_finish_positive
execution: Always open the seeded challenger and evaluate through compile index min(H,65), unless it exhausts. If any verified challenger endpoint beats the incumbent at or before this point, finish the entire challenger trajectory and return the best verified endpoint.
If no certificate by index 65 and challenger remains, stop with incumbent when best_gap>11; otherwise continue through index min(H,129).
If a certificate appears during the second interval, finish the entire challenger trajectory and return the best verified endpoint.
If no certificate by index 129 and challenger remains, stop with incumbent when best_gap>9; otherwise finish the entire challenger trajectory and return the best verified endpoint.
The incumbent is retained throughout; final live nodes can never exceed two-arm live nodes.

threshold_origin.note: Both values were already the maximum active-positive gaps in the preregistered n=12 development set. The failed v0 holdout motivated removal of the initial gate and full finishing after positive evidence; it did not raise these numeric thresholds.

comparators.fixed64: initial plus 64 further challenger compilations; stop at first certificate else incumbent
comparators.fixed128: initial plus 128 further challenger compilations; stop at first certificate else incumbent
comparators.exhaustive_challenger: full independent seeded challenger; final min with incumbent
comparators.v0_policy: frozen 25/11/9 policy, reported only as historical architecture comparator without retuning

co_primary_metrics: Aggregate exhaustive gain and v1 gain recovered fraction
Total v1 challenger compilations as fraction of exhaustive challenger compilations
v1 versus fixed64/fixed128 quality at charged compute

predeclared_usefulness_rule.if_exhaustive_gain_positive: pass only if v1 recovers >=70% of aggregate exhaustive challenger gain, uses <=70% of exhaustive challenger compilations, and has strictly positive aggregate gain over two-arm
predeclared_usefulness_rule.if_exhaustive_gain_zero: no demonstrated challenger value; report without reinterpretation

scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering only. This is a transfer test of one VoC architecture, not a general proof-search result.
